title: Baggage Conveyor w/Install
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE.U.S. AIR FORCES IN EUROPE.FA5613  700 CONS PK
detail_text: SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE (SSN) BAGGAGE CONVEYOR W/INSTALL for RAMSTEIN AIR BASE (RAB), GERMANY This is a request for information only. This is not a request for quote/proposal and there is no solicitation package available at this time. The United States Air Force, 700th Contracting Squadron, Kapaun Air Station, Germany is seeking sources to provide a Baggage Conveyor w/Install at Ramstein Air Base, Germany. The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code is 333922, Conveyor and Conveying Equipment Manufacturing. The Product Service Code is 3910, Conveyors . Description of Requirement This requirement is for services to provide a Baggage Conveyor w/Install. The conveyor system shall be capable of handling all items within the following limits: Weight: Maximum: 150 pounds (68 kg) per bag Minimum: 1 pound (0.5 kg) per bag Size: Maximum: 30 inches (760 mm) wide 60 inches (1520 mm) long 36 inches (915 mm) high Minimum: 3 inches (75 mm) wide 12 inches (305 mm) long 3 inches (75 mm) high Information Required If your firm is interested, please provide the following information to the 700th Contracting Office personnel listed no later than 12:00 PM CEST on 13 March 2026. Company Name, Point of Contact, E-mail address, Telephone number, SAM UEI, and a capability statement This is for informational and planning purposes only. All information submitted is voluntary. The government will not pay for information gathered as a result of this notice. This sources sought notice also does not commit the Government to issue a solicitation package.
